decision.reason: [ev-00bf6ae74af0] is a single changelog line saying only that provider logs were "improved". It links to PR #9562 but doesn't say what changed. It names no specific log message, format, level, field or configuration key, gives no before/after behaviour and says nothing about which environments are affected or what happens to them. Writing the subject, change, applicability and consequence would need the PR's diff or description.
